info.name: Ice HR
info.description:
Every Ice HR endpoint, with tests in each request. No login needed.

Pick the **Ice HR - local** environment, then send requests one by one, or run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Requests that create something save its id in a collection variable (employeeId, departmentId, leaveId) for the requests after them. The first and last requests reset the data, so the collection can run again and again.

Business rules: README section 5. Swagger: http://localhost:8080/swagger

exec: // Runs after every request in the collection.

request.description: Is Ice HR up? `today` is the date (in Toronto) that every date rule uses.
Puts every record back to the seed. New ids start at 1001 again.

exec: pm.test("range 80000 to 115000", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.minSalary).to.eql(80000); pm.expect(j.maxSalary).to.eql(115000); });
pm.test("Engineering, 14 active", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("Engineering"); pm.expect(d.employeeCount).to.eql(14); });
pm.test("Location header points to the new department", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql("/api/v1/departments/" + pm.response.json().id));

item.name: Create department with a taken name (409)

exec: pm.test("only location changed", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.location).to.eql("Montreal"); pm.expect(d.name).to.eql("Data Science"); });
pm.test("managerId cleared because it was left out", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().managerId).to.be.null);
pm.test("60 in 3 pages", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.totalElements).to.eql(60); pm.expect(p.totalPages).to.eql(3); pm.expect(p.content).to.have.lengthOf(20); });

item.name: Search by department, best paid first

exec: pm.test("Ethan Nguyen, 80000", () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.firstName).to.eql("Ethan"); pm.expect(e.salary).to.eql(80000); });
pm.test("ACTIVE with an id from 1001", () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql("ACTIVE"); pm.expect(e.id).to.be.at.least(1001); });

item.name: Make Aisha report to Ethan (422 loop)

exec: pm.test("includes Ethan to Jack (13 to 17)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(e => e.id)).to.include.members([13, 14, 15, 16, 17]));

item.name: Request vacation for the new employee

exec: // A Monday at least two weeks ahead, with Monday to Friday in the same year.
pm.test("PENDING, 5 days", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(l.days).to.eql(5); });

item.name: Request leave for a terminated employee (422)
Approve by someone who is not the manager (422)

exec: pm.test("APPROVED by 9", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(l.approverId).to.eql(9); pm.expect(l.decidedAt).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("reason is required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors[0]).to.eql({ field: "reason", message: "is required" }));
pm.test("REJECTED with the reason", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("REJECTED"); pm.expect(l.decisionReason).to.eql("Release week"); });
pm.test("REJECTED with a reason", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().decisionReason).to.eql("Holiday coverage is already full."));
